trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: For all of its austerity, it is moving.
trap.right: For all its austerity, it is moving.
trap.why: Português “apesar de toda a sua austeridade”; for all não leva of antes do possessivo.

mcq.q: Which sentence concedes a point about austerity?
opts: For all of its austerity it moving.
For all its austerity, it is moving.

fix.wrong: For all of its length, it is gripping.
fix.right: For all its length, it is gripping.

fix.wrong: Admittedly, the film is austere, however moving.
fix.right: Admittedly, the film is austere. Yet it is moving.
